Irradiance Volumes

Each environment box (EnvMapEffectBox) lights the area inside it with a baked irradiance volume. Smithbox finds a box's volume by its volume ID property only. Vanilla boxes leave that property at -1, and the game then reads the ID from the last three digits of the name, so these boxes have no volume in Smithbox. Fill Volume IDs writes the ID the game already uses into the property, which changes nothing in game and keeps the link if the box is renamed. One undo reverts it.
